description: This file defines the SudoCommandResponse interface for handling responses related to policy sudo commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method signatures, default implementations, and nested classes for JSON field handling.

classes.name: SudoCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing responses to sudo commands within the policies API, extending command response and entity handling capabilities.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A static nested class defining JSON field constants used in SudoCommandResponse, specifically for the policy ID payload.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer, indicating no specific resource path for SudoCommandResponse objects.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string associated with Sudo command responses.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the JSON entity associated with the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the response.
